About this item

  • 18 PIECES: The Chicago Cutlery Insignia set features 17 specialty knives and 1 pair of scissor - made with durable, high-quality stainless steel blades that resist stains and corrosion, ensuring they remain sharp and ready to use for years to come. Set includes: (1) 8" Chef Knife, (1) 8" Slicing Knife, (1) 7" Serrated Bread Knife, (1) 7" Santoku Knife, (1) 5" Boning Knife, (1) 5.5" Utility Knife, (1) 3.5" Paring Knife, (1) 3" Peeler Knife, (8) 4.5" Steak Knives, (1) Shears / Scissor with Opener.
  • BUILT IN SHARPNER: With a unique built-in sharpener in the acacia wood block, the Insignia knife set makes it easy to keep your knives sharp and ready for any cutting task.
  • 26 DEGREE TAPER: The blades on all the knives are made with a 26 degree taper grind edge, providing optimal sharpness and precision for effortless cutting through meats, vegetables, fruits and more.
  • STRONG & STURDY: Excellent craftsmanship in each knife, which provides added strength and durability to the knife's construction, ensuring it can handle even the toughest cutting tasks with ease.
  • ERGONOMIC HANDLES: Each handle comes with a curve-optimized handle that is ergonomically designed for easy and comfortable gripping, even during extended use. The handles provide a secure, slip-resistant grip, making the knives safe and easy to use.

Product Description

The Chicago Cutlery Insignia set includes 18 pieces, with 17 specialty knives and 1 pair of scissors, all made with durable, high-quality stainless steel blades that resist stains and corrosion. The set features a built-in sharpener in the acacia wood block, ensuring knives remain sharp and ready for use. The blades have a 26-degree taper grind edge, providing optimal sharpness and precision. Each knife has a metal tang, providing added strength and durability. The ergonomically designed handles offer a secure, slip-resistant grip, making the knives safe and easy to use even during extended use.

  • Sykes
    5 out of 5 stars
    Finally a quality knife set
    Reviewed in the United States on November 27, 2023
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I was first drawn to these because the steak knives have a smooth blade. So many cheap, and even many more expensive knife sets have serrated steak knives which I can't stand. A steak knife should slice your food, not tear it. These slice with ease.

    I've been using the knives for a little over a month and haven't had a need to sharpen them yet, so I can't speak to the built-in sharpening tool, but they are holding an edge well. And that's with cleaning them in the dishwasher. Yes, I know hand washing is better, but in my household that's simply not happening much of the time, and these knives haven't punished us for it.

    The handles are very comfortable, and full tang, 3-rivot design makes them very sturdy. I'm expecting they'll last for decades.

    My one complaint is that when all the knives are in the block they all look so similar that you might end up grabbing 2 or 3 different knives trying to find the one you want. I'm not actually sure I'd want anything changed to 'fix' that though... I think any sort of labeling would detract from the design, and the issue is just too minor.

About this Item

  • 18 PIECES: The Chicago Cutlery Insignia set features 17 specialty knives and 1 pair of scissor - made with durable, high-quality stainless steel blades that resist stains and corrosion, ensuring they remain sharp and ready to use for years to come. Set includes: (1) 8" Chef Knife, (1) 8" Slicing Knife, (1) 7" Serrated Bread Knife, (1) 7" Santoku Knife, (1) 5" Boning Knife, (1) 5.5" Utility Knife, (1) 3.5" Paring Knife, (1) 3" Peeler Knife, (8) 4.5" Steak Knives, (1) Shears / Scissor with Opener.
  • BUILT IN SHARPNER: With a unique built-in sharpener in the acacia wood block, the Insignia knife set makes it easy to keep your knives sharp and ready for any cutting task.
  • 26 DEGREE TAPER: The blades on all the knives are made with a 26 degree taper grind edge, providing optimal sharpness and precision for effortless cutting through meats, vegetables, fruits and more.
  • STRONG & STURDY: Excellent craftsmanship in each knife, which provides added strength and durability to the knife's construction, ensuring it can handle even the toughest cutting tasks with ease.
  • ERGONOMIC HANDLES: Each handle comes with a curve-optimized handle that is ergonomically designed for easy and comfortable gripping, even during extended use. The handles provide a secure, slip-resistant grip, making the knives safe and easy to use.

Product Description

The Chicago Cutlery Insignia set includes 18 pieces, with 17 specialty knives and 1 pair of scissors, all made with durable, high-quality stainless steel blades that resist stains and corrosion. The set features a built-in sharpener in the acacia wood block, ensuring knives remain sharp and ready for use. The blades have a 26-degree taper grind edge, providing optimal sharpness and precision. Each knife has a metal tang, providing added strength and durability. The ergonomically designed handles offer a secure, slip-resistant grip, making the knives safe and easy to use even during extended use.
